hint.restart: Off the solution path. Restart to continue.
hud.controls: Arrows Move · Shift Dig · Ctrl Pour · Z Undo · H Hint · Esc Pause
extra.rule.push.name: Push and step up
extra.rule.push.text: Walk into one crate to push it. Crate chains cannot move. Step up one tile when both spaces above are clear.
extra.rule.ladder.name: Ladders
extra.rule.ladder.text: You stay in a ladder. Up enters the rung above; Down goes lower. Ladders do not support crates.
extra.rule.pour.name: Pour sand
extra.rule.pour.text: Ctrl and Left or Right pours one bag into a free tile. Pour beside a wall or into a pit for a reliable step.
extra.rule.plate_door.name: Plates and doors
extra.rule.plate_door.text: Press every plate with the same sign to open its door. You, crates and sand press plates. Occupied doors stay open.
extra.rule.fall.name: Losing support
extra.rule.fall.text: You and crates fall without support. Crates can stack. There is no fall damage.
chapter.unavailable: Not available yet. Play M01–M07 in Basics.
level.Q01.title: One blast opens the way
level.Q01.discovery: Blast cracked rock. Bedrock and crates stay intact.
level.Q01.hint.1: Cracked rock blocks the way between you and the crate.
level.Q01.hint.2: A blast clears cracked rock, while bedrock and crates survive.
level.Q01.hint.3: Walk beside the rock, blast right, then push the crate into its socket.
level.Q02.title: Blasts reach through walls
level.Q02.discovery: Bedrock stops you, but it does not shield the rock behind it.
level.Q02.hint.1: Cracked rock supports the crate behind the wall.
level.Q02.hint.2: A blast acts by distance, even through bedrock.
level.Q02.hint.3: Reach the ladder, climb once, and place a blast to the right.
level.Q03.title: Light it, then watch
level.Q03.discovery: A burning fuse carries the blast to distant rock.
level.Q03.hint.1: A row of fuses leads to the distant rock.
level.Q03.hint.2: Fire travels along the fuse and triggers a distant blast.
level.Q03.hint.3: Blast the left end, let the whole turn settle, then reach the exit.
level.Q04.title: Slow stones still fall
level.Q04.discovery: Break the support. Slow gravel fills the bin before the turn ends.
level.Q04.hint.1: Cracked rock holds the gravel above the bin.
level.Q04.hint.2: Gravel falls slowly. The turn waits until it has settled.
level.Q04.hint.3: Walk beside the support and blast right. Let the bin fill.
level.G01.title: One Drop Opens the Way
level.G01.discovery: Dig out the plug. Acid flows down the shaft and consumes the etched stone on contact, revealing the exit below.
level.G01.hint.1: One layer of etched stone blocks the exit at the bottom of the shaft.
level.G01.hint.2: The packed-earth plug is beside the acid pool. Removing it lets acid enter the shaft.
level.G01.hint.3: Walk left three tiles, dig left, then wait for the reaction to finish and step left into the shaft.
level.G02.title: Same Mark, Same Reaction
level.G02.discovery: Both colors of etched stone dissolve in acid. The unmarked hard rock holding the pool stays intact.
level.G02.hint.1: The pool rests on unmarked hard rock. The two differently colored stones in the shaft share one etched mark.
level.G02.hint.2: Read the mark to predict what acid can dissolve, rather than relying on color.
level.G02.hint.3: Walk left three tiles and dig left. Once both etched stones dissolve, step left and drop to the exit.
level.G03.title: Smoke Rises
level.G03.discovery: Open the top vent. Light smoke rises into the upper collector, and the goal stays lit once its gauge reaches the mark.
level.G03.hint.1: The only goal is the collector above the shaft. It needs light smoke.
level.G03.hint.2: Packed earth seals the smoke chamber at the top. Smoke seeks the upper opening.
level.G03.hint.3: Walk left four tiles and dig left. Watch smoke rise into the collector gauge.
level.G04.title: Fog Sinks
level.G04.discovery: Heavy fog moves the opposite way to smoke. Open the bottom vent and it sinks into the lower collector.
level.G04.hint.1: The collector is below this time, and its material icon shows heavy fog.
level.G04.hint.2: Look for a downward opening. Heavy fog sinks through the bottom vent.
level.G04.hint.3: Walk left four tiles and dig left. Wait for the lower gauge to reach its mark.
level.G05.title: The Fading Plug
level.G05.discovery: The lever starts the fungal plug’s lifetime. It fades during the same device sequence, releasing sand into the collector.
level.G05.hint.1: The fungal plug holds two bags of sand above the collector.
level.G05.hint.2: The lever and plug share a symbol. Pull it and watch the device sequence finish.
level.G05.hint.3: Walk left four tiles, then press up on the lever. No further move or timed input is needed.
level.G06.title: Water the Vine
level.G06.discovery: Water reaching the roots grows a ladder of fixed height. The water feeds the roots; the vine carries you upward.
level.G06.hint.1: The exit is above and to the left. The empty shaft has vine roots at its bottom.
level.G06.hint.2: Open the pool’s earth plug to water the roots. The grown vine ladder will stay.
level.G06.hint.3: Walk left four tiles and dig left. Step left onto the vine, climb up twice, then walk left to the exit.
level.G08.title: Bouncing Mushroom
level.G08.discovery: Fall onto the mushroom to rise two tiles automatically. The vine ladder catches you, so you can stop and walk to the exit.
level.G08.hint.1: The exit and vine ladder are one tile above your current floor. A mushroom waits below the left ledge.
level.G08.hint.2: Step off the ledge onto the mushroom. It sends you to the ladder without a jump button.
level.G08.hint.3: Walk left to the ledge and step off. Once the ladder catches you, walk left to the exit.
level.G09.title: Seesaw
level.G09.discovery: Push the iron crate down onto one end. The wooden crate on the other end rises two tiles and lands in the nearby upper socket.
level.G09.hint.1: The wooden crate is already on the left end. Its socket is on the upper ledge.
level.G09.hint.2: Drop the iron crate onto the empty right end. The board shows where the wooden crate will land.
level.G09.hint.3: Walk left twice, then push the iron crate left twice. Its landing launches the wooden crate into the upper left socket.
level.G10.title: Sand on the Seesaw
level.G10.discovery: Stay on the exit shore and use sand to launch the crate into its socket.
level.G10.hint.1: The crate needs its socket, and you need the shore exit. The pit is one end of the seesaw.
level.G10.hint.2: You cannot climb back from the pit. Sand can press the end while you stay at the exit.
level.G10.hint.3: Walk left four times to the exit, then pour sand left.
level.F01.title: Wood Burns Away
level.F01.discovery: Pull the brazier lever to ignite the wooden barrier. It burns away during the same settlement, opening the passage.
level.F01.hint.1: The two-block-high wooden barrier is inside the brazier's marked area.
level.F01.hint.2: Stand on the lever to the left of the brazier and press Up. Let the ignition phase finish.
level.F01.hint.3: Walk right twice, pull the lever, then keep walking right to the exit after the barrier burns away.
level.F02.title: Freeze a Bridge
level.F02.discovery: The frost vent turns water inside its outline into lasting solid ice, making a bridge across the pool.
level.F02.hint.1: The pool is two blocks deep and its far bank is too high. The vent outlines only the top row of water.
level.F02.hint.2: Press Up at the lever on the left bank to freeze the top row into solid support.
level.F02.hint.3: Walk right once and pull the lever, then cross the ice to the exit. If you enter the water first, use the ladder on the left to climb back out.
level.F03.title: Melt the Plug
level.F03.discovery: The heat vent turns the ice plug inside its outline into water, which drains into the collector below.
level.F03.hint.1: The shaft beneath the ice leads to the collector. Two blocks of ice supply exactly enough water.
level.F03.hint.2: The ice will not melt on its own. Try the heat vent's lever on the left.
level.F03.hint.3: Walk right three times and press Up at the lever. Let the melted water drain into the collector.
level.F04.title: Explosions Ignite Too
level.F04.discovery: An explosion ignites surviving wood within half its radius. The fire then burns the barrier away.
level.F04.hint.1: There is no brazier here, but your bag holds one charge.
level.F04.hint.2: The inner blast area ignites surviving flammable material. Place the blast in the empty block just left of the barrier.
level.F04.hint.3: Walk right three times and place a charge to the right. After the wood burns away, keep walking right to the exit.
level.F07.title: One Push Across the Ice
level.F07.discovery: Push a crate onto ice and it slides to the socket against the far wall during the same settlement. You stay one block behind the push.
level.F07.hint.1: Five icy floor blocks lead from the crate to a socket beside the end wall.
level.F07.hint.2: The crate keeps sliding once it reaches ice. The wall stops it in the socket.
level.F07.hint.3: Walk right four times. The last move pushes the crate onto ice; let it slide to the socket at the far right.
level.F08.title: The Gust Vent
level.F08.discovery: After each valid action, the gust moves the light wooden crate one block right. Four gusts carry it into the raised socket.
level.F08.hint.1: You cannot reach the upper shelf. Both its crate and socket are inside the right-pointing gust outline.
level.F08.hint.2: Each valid action ends with one gust. You do not need to wait in real time or touch the crate.
level.F08.hint.3: Walk right four times in the lower passage. The four settlements carry the crate from the left end of the shelf into the socket.
level.F09.title: Freeze a Sliding Path
level.F09.discovery: Freeze the top row of the pool into a continuous ice track, then push the crate onto it to slide into the far socket.
level.F09.hint.1: A whole stretch of ice is missing before the socket. The frost vent outlines exactly the top row of the pool.
level.F09.hint.2: Freeze the continuous track before pushing the crate so it can slide all the way to the end wall.
level.F09.hint.3: Walk right once and press Up to freeze the water. Walk right three more times to push the crate onto the ice; it stops in the socket beside the wall.
level.Q07.title: A cart keeps rolling
level.Q07.discovery: One push rolls the cart and its load to the end of the track.
level.Q07.hint.1: The crate rides a cart. Its track ends beneath the socket.
level.Q07.hint.2: A cart keeps rolling after one push, taking its load with it.
level.Q07.hint.3: Walk to the cart and push it right once.
level.Q08.title: Solid in the lantern light
level.Q08.discovery: Push a crate onto the lit bridge, then step back to let it drop.
level.Q08.hint.1: The socket is below a ghostly crystal bridge.
level.Q08.hint.2: Your lantern makes the bridge solid within two tiles. Step away and it vanishes.
level.Q08.hint.3: Walk right three times, then step left once.
level.Q09.title: A crate inside a crate
level.Q09.discovery: Blast the outer shell. The inner crate fits the marked socket.
level.Q09.hint.1: This crate has an outer shell. The small socket wants its inner crate.
level.Q09.hint.2: A blast removes one shell and leaves the next crate in place.
level.Q09.hint.3: Reach the crate, blast right, then push the inner crate three tiles.
level.Q10.title: Clear the track
level.Q10.discovery: Blast the blocked track, then push the loaded cart again.
level.Q10.hint.2: The cart stops before the rock. Clear it and push again.
level.Q10.hint.3: Push the cart to the obstacle, blast right, then push right once.
level.E04.title: Clear, then dispatch
level.E04.discovery: Clear the track with a blast and push the cart to the socket.
level.E04.hint.1: The cart can deliver the crate, but its track is blocked.
level.E04.hint.2: The cart stops at cracked rock. Its frame and crate survive a blast.
level.E04.hint.3: Push the cart to the obstacle, blast right, then push again.
level.E05.title: An ice lane for cargo
level.E05.discovery: Freeze a water surface into a lane and slide the crate to its socket.
level.E05.hint.1: The vent marks the water surface between the crate and socket.
level.E05.hint.2: Freeze a continuous lane first. The crate slides only on ice.
level.E05.hint.3: Step right and pull the switch, then walk right twice.
level.E06.title: A heavy crate opens the gate
level.E06.discovery: Overload the bridge. The iron crate sinks onto the underwater plate.
level.E06.hint.1: The bridge holds two weights. A plate waits in the water below.
level.E06.hint.2: The iron crate fills the load limit. Step onto it to overload the bridge.
level.E06.hint.3: Push the crate onto the bridge, climb it, then use it to step back to the gate.
extra.controls.bomb: Hold B with a direction, or drag a bomb to an adjacent tile.
level.E01.title: Sand Holds the Door
level.E01.discovery: Leave sand in the pressure-plate pit, then walk through the door to the exit.
level.E01.hint.1: The door and the plate in the floor pit share a circle symbol. You have one bag of sand.
level.E01.hint.2: The door closes when you leave the plate. Sand can keep the plate pressed while you move on.
level.E01.hint.3: Walk right three tiles and pour right into the pit. Once the sand settles, walk right five tiles to the exit.
level.E02.title: Send the Crate First
level.E02.discovery: Send the crate through the portal to the socket’s side, then push it into the goal.
level.E02.hint.1: Matching circle portals sit on opposite sides of the wall. The socket is one tile beyond the receiving portal.
level.E02.hint.2: Send the crate first. Then climb the ladder on the left portal and cross the upper passage to reach the crate from behind.
level.E02.hint.3: Push the crate right onto the portal, then step right onto the ladder. Climb up twice, go right three times, climb down twice, and push right into the socket.
level.E03.title: Load Before Releasing Water
level.E03.discovery: Load the crate onto the lift first. Then release water so the collector triggers the lift.
level.E03.hint.1: The only crate socket is above the lift. Filling the collector raises the platform once.
level.E03.hint.2: Push the crate onto the platform before pulling the lever. Releasing water first sends an empty lift upward.
level.E03.hint.3: Push the crate left twice, walk right three tiles to the lever, then press up to release the water.
